findings.body:
Gain 2, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: rare - a signed-off prototype has a labelled root-level file named ` café.tsx` that sorts first, or a labelled filename contains a newline.
Owner's exact title: Not done: The Demo only row names only files whose names use letters, digits and the signs . _ / -, and says "and N other files" for the rest, so the row never holds a shell character.
The NUL-separated listing still goes through `repo.git`, which strips leading whitespace from its entire output (`src/forge/repo.py:405-411`). The first example is therefore looked up as `café.tsx`, not ` café.tsx`. Separately, the shared blob reader skips paths containing newlines (`src/forge/repo.py:193-194`). These labelled files are omitted from the count, and the Demo only row disappears if no other labelled file remains. The earlier round already raised omission of non-ASCII names; accepting these exclusions would require narrowing the clause.

why: The Before production list puts tracked file names into the Demo only row's Say text, which is printed inside double quotes, so a file name with shell characters could run on the agent's machine when pasted into a command.
